knownIssues.impact: YOLO12 segmentation .pt preset rows remain blocked because official yolo12*-seg.pt weights were not resolvable in the validation environment.
YOLO26 NCNN failed 20/20 in targeted matrix; product must not expose NCNN for YOLO26. Use ONNX or TensorRT.
COCO128, COCO128-seg, and Total-Text runs are engineering lifecycle evidence, not customer-domain production accuracy proof.
OCR 5 epoch pp-ocrv4-mobile-det row was restored from an earlier report path; separate full-lifecycle ppocrv4-mobile-det row remains a passed evidence source.
